title: Chain rule
text:
Chain rule
d/dx f(g(x)) = f′(g(x)) · g′(x)
e.g. d/dx (x²+1)³ = 6x(x²+1)²

title: Trig derivatives
text:
Trig derivatives
d/dx sin x = cos x
d/dx cos x = −sin x

title: Limits
text:
Limits
lim sin x / x = 1  as x → 0

title: Integration basics
text:
Integration basics
